newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares ease in active trade.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares ease in active trade.

text.p: Shares on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE) eased in active trade last week.

CIC Holdings was the most heavily traded share after 184,900 shares changed hands, while Engen followed with 81,100 shares traded. Pep Namibia shares were also actively traded with a total of 64,100 shares bought and sold.
Gold Fields Namibia's shares started the week at N$1.32, rising to a week's high of N$1.46 before settling at $1.40 at the end of the week.
A total of 494,300 shares worth N$8.7 million traded during the week and the NSE overall index eased to 241.86 from the previous week's 244.81.
The NSE local index fell to 146.97 compared with 148.49 a week ago.
